I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I’m missing the actual content.

What I need from you:
- The full transcript text (doctor–patient conversation).
- The differential diagnosis (DDx) JSON content.

Notes:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source and the DDx to enrich reasoning only when consistent with the transcript.
- I will not invent data (e.g., vitals, meds, doses) beyond what the transcript or DDx provides.
- If there is any conflict between transcript and DDx, I will include both items and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will output in the exact structure and headings you specified (Subjective; Objective; Assessment & Plan with issues; Quality checks).

If you can paste the transcript and the DDx JSON here, I’ll generate the complete SOAP note right away.
